description: Score the page HTML you supply (nothing is fetched) with 7 deterministic on-page checks: title present, title length, meta description, canonical, exactly one H1, structured data, image alt text. Returns url_seo_score 0-100 and per-check booleans; no authority or backlink data; costs $0.01 USDC.

html.description: Complete page HTML, up to 512 KB.

url.description: Canonical URL for the supplied page.

name: score_page_seo
